_note: This file is a declarative mmpretrain configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or CLI entry points. It defines dictionary-based settings for training a BEiT Vision Transformer on ImageNet-1K. No example statements are included per the rule: 'Do not include files that do not have code we can call with a simple argparse cli module.'
config_purpose: BEiT-base-p16 benchmark configuration for 100-epoch ImageNet-1K training with cosine LR schedule, Mixup/CutMix augmentation, and AdamW optimizer with layer-wise decay

key_components.model: ImageClassifier with BEiTViT backbone (base arch, 224x224, patch_size=16, relative position bias, no absolute position embedding)
key_components.head: LinearClsHead with 1000 classes, 768 input channels, LabelSmoothLoss (smoothing=0.1)
key_components.train_pipeline: LoadImageFromFile -> RandomResizedCrop -> RandomFlip -> RandAugment -> RandomErasing -> PackInputs
key_components.optimizer: AdamW (lr=4e-3, weight_decay=0.05) with LearningRateDecayOptimWrapperConstructor (layer_decay_rate=0.65, zero decay on LN/bias/pos_embed/gamma)
key_components.scheduler: LinearLR warmup (epochs 0-20, start_factor=1e-4) then CosineAnnealingLR (epochs 20-100, eta_min=1e-6)
key_components.runtime: 100 epochs, batch_size=128 per device, checkpoint every epoch (keep 2), seed=0
